name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1925: His F-Sets meter read 118 of 135 while the game read 116. Asking the live board settled it: 119 stored pieces, three of which do not belong - Blood Crescent, a UNIQUE already ticked in his Holy Grail and the misroute he reported earlier whose fix corrected the routing and never repaired the row already written, plus two pieces the game own Remaining page lists as missing. 119 minus 3 is 116, and the meter now reads 116 of 135 at 85 percent with 19 still missing, matching the game exactly. The safeguard he asked for lives on the WRITE side, because a load-time sweep can always be out-run by a new caller: a name that is not a set piece can no longer enter the set store. The obvious version of that rule would have deleted 116 real finds, because toggleSetPiece writes every set piece into the found log on purpose, so the true invariant is narrower - a unique must never appear in the set store. The missing-list repair fires once per reading, or the day he finds one of those pieces and ticks it the next load would strip it again forever. The meter also floors instead of rounding, because 85.9 printed as 86 while the game prints 85. And the Activity Ledger now separates what changed from what was merely confirmed: 324 rows of you already had this one collapse into one line he can open.
